messages.text: When I try to launch them this happens

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1166065212537970722> found the real cause, and the earlier "fixed" message was wrong, sorry. strikes were taking buildings off every province at once, which crashed whenever a small province went below 0. that's fixed and live now: drones and missiles launch, and they destroy exactly the number shown in the report

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1166065212537970722> found it, small building stacks could go negative when a strike hit them and that crashed the launch. fixed, should be live within the hour. try launching again after that
